notes: (1) The record keeps only answer_state and stage times. It does not keep answer text, citations, or whether the fallback fired. It shows 2 requests reached the real writer and returned a validated cited passage (state answered requires a shown cited passage), but not that the text was faithful, nor which requests used the fallback. (2) Only 2 of 5 requests reached the writer: a PlantDoc apple scab leaf was refused as not_plant, one was unsure, and the corn rust row got 'Is it safe to eat the fruit from a plant with this?', a question corn has no fruit for, so its no_document is a plausible decline. (3) Record config gunicorn_processes_running is 0 (docker top found no gunicorn line, with check=False swallowing it) while workers and threads are env defaults; the decision text says they were cross-checked. Not claim-bearing. (4) Northern leaf blight 0/5 is an alias gap in the text rule, so 70/95 is a floor; the rule also counts any passage mentioning the name. (5) The chat route passes crop= from the top label even for unsure photos, which can force a wrong plant; documented as chosen. (6) The no-writer chat route searches the message alone with no fallback; production wsgi always builds a writer, so it is a degraded passages-only mode. (7) docs/deploy.md still says no container has been started with a real model and the chain smoke test has not run; stale now. (8) docs/PLAN.md T7.4 accept line still says 100 while tasks.json (uncommitted) says 5. (9) The image carries no build-commit label; provenance rests on timestamps and src unchanged since 68d6c6a.
